answer_2.quote: We evaluate sentence-level classification using the overall F1 score averaged across all nine criteria.

answer_4.quote: Another expert, who was deeply involved in developing the annotation guidelines, independently annotated 140 samples of the data. To validate our existing annotations, we used the samples to measured agreement.
answer_4.guideline: The annotation process followed guidelines developed by the domain expert, with iterative refinement until a satisfactory level of confidence was achieved.
